s01e001.title: What Happens When Juni Waits?
s01e001.premise: Juni rushes to finish a bridge for her friends, but the wood isn’t ready. She learns that taking a moment to be patient helps everyone succeed. Young viewers see how waiting can turn a small act into a bright surprise.
